task_specification.objective: Deliver a release-convergence increment that restores automatic-attack causality, makes the authored cemetery readable and traversable in ordinary play, and completes the run/result/retry contract with tester-ready evidence hooks.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate has three coupled release blockers: automatic combat reaches attack completion without a bounded audible report, the authored cemetery is framed too tightly around the central mausoleum causing Warden/route occlusion, and cemetery lighting remains blue-flat and underexposed, weakening landmark and path readability. These need separate integration repairs while preserving the native authored map and audio bindings.

stop_conditions: Stop after the three bounded implementation families are complete and candidate-side checks are green; defer formal issue closure and evidence verdicts to Tester/GameLoop Runtime.
Do not replace or surgically modify the preserved authored cemetery package or coupled audio assets; stop if a fix would require reopening those frozen selections.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause approach from prior transform-tuning attempts: repair runtime event and bus bindings through an explicit product adapter, isolate camera framing through a gameplay composition wrapper, and layer authored lighting/exposure controls plus lifecycle state guards. This preserves the accepted assets while addressing causality, occlusion, readability, and run completion as separate surfaces.

code: Run native Godot project checks and static parser/import validation for touched scripts and scenes.
Verify touched target paths are candidate-relative and no preserved asset package is replaced or split.
runtime: Tester/GameLoop Runtime recaptures automatic-combat audio states: SEMI click, quick AUTO tap, release, and lifecycle reset, including source-event timeline and mixed output.

Tester/GameLoop Runtime recaptures cemetery spawn, critical route, cardinal landmark, and boundary movement states with screenshots plus runtime spatial/collision data; retest failed camera and exposure cells first.

Tester/GameLoop Runtime runs an ordinary successful route through Result and Retry, then verifies fresh-run state, HUD/choice focus behavior, truthful choice deltas, and branch receipts; formal verdicts and issue closure remain host-owned.
visual: Inspect shipped gameplay framing at spawn, route, and landmark viewpoints for central-building/Warden visibility, external depth, readable warm/cool lighting separation, and absence of blue-flat underexposure.

Inspect active HUD and choice/result pages at target resolution for visual hierarchy, silhouettes/icons, truthful current/new deltas capped at three decision-relevant stats, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.

done_when: A single automatic attack completion emits exactly one bounded, recognizable firearm transient through the retained player-report path; release stops cadence and lifecycle reset clears pending audio state.
Concrete hit, miss, and enemy spatial feedback remain separable from the player firearm report, with no duplicate replay from generic shot VFX.
A same-session black-box retest can trigger one SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap and observe one report each, while white-box state or logs expose event source and reset reason.
tasks.instructions: Repair automatic-combat integration at the product-owned weapon and combat-feedback boundary. Trace attack completion into the retained lantern report owner, add an explicit one-shot report guard and lifecycle reset, and keep impact, character, and enemy spatial stems separate. Preserve the bound MournlightAudio scene and Lantern semantic streams; do not replace audio assets. Add concise candidate-side diagnostics only as needed to prove event source, cadence, and reset without making telemetry the acceptance itself.
tasks.title: Restore automatic attack report causality

done_when: The cemetery has a larger traversable scale or clearly expanded playable footprint with an external world/external depth beyond the playable boundary.
The central building/landmark and Warden remain visible from ordinary movement replay through spawn, route, and cardinal landmark views; no disappearance or occlusion drift occurs.

Native authored streets and terrain remain the sole visual map, with aligned collision and navigation across the playable boundary/perimeter; no pass-through, void, proxy-floor, or boundary escape is observed.
Lighting and exposure provide readable warm route pools, cool ambient separation, and landmark silhouettes without blue-flat underexposure.
A same-session black-box ordinary movement replay is paired with white-box spatial, collision, and camera-fill receipts for the failed cells.
tasks.instructions: Repair authored cemetery presentation using a composition-wrapper and lighting/exposure strategy rather than replacing the preserved map. Expand the traversable scale where the current framing feels cramped, retain an external world/external depth beyond the boundary, and reframe the camera so the central building/landmark and Warden stay readable during ordinary movement replay. Verify collision alignment at the boundary/perimeter and prevent disappearance or occlusion on traversal. Rebalance environment/world lighting, fog, and landmark accent lights for readable routes and silhouettes while keeping native streets, structures, props, and materials intact.
tasks.title: Reframe and relight the authored cemetery

done_when: A complete ordinary run can reach an authoritative terminal success/result state, and Retry starts a fresh run without stale combat, audio, HUD, or pause state.
Result and Retry affordances are keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focusable with visible focus states.

Upgrade and weapon choices lead with authored silhouettes or icons and compact stat icons, show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, and never show NEW or LOCKED as a placeholder in the CURRENT value column.
The run HUD communicates health/resources, wave/timer, XP/level, weapon/build identity, and objective state with restrained readable hierarchy during active play and terminal states.
Candidate-side lifecycle and UI checks provide direct same-session black-box and white-box retest points for success, result, retry, and reset.
tasks.instructions: Complete the ordinary end-of-run release path and presentation contracts around the existing authoritative run state. Ensure a successful route transitions to Result, Retry resets authoritative state and all coupled combat/audio/HUD presenters, and choice cards replace text-stacked presentation with authored silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states. Keep first-run guidance and InputMap bindings intact. Expose bounded tester preparation/advance hooks only if required for branch-local verification, guarded from release exports; prepare must not auto-transition and must report branch id, setup generation, requested/resolved/reset-isolation receipts.
